interaction: Paint on an easel canvas with a generative bristle brush that responds to pointer speed and pressure — pick one of six paints and three brush sizes, switch on Mix to pick up wet paint already on the canvas, undo, clear or press 'Random stroke' (keyboard friendly) — then 'Frame it' to hang your painting first in a gallery of generated sample works for this visit.
notes: Framed paintings are kept in memory for the current visit only.
